Cargo.toml:
[workspace]
members = ["app"]
resolver = "3"
[workspace.package]
edition = "2024"
[workspace.dependencies]
service = { path = "service" }
support = { path = "support" }
app/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "app"
version = "0.1.0"
edition.workspace = true
[dependencies]
service.workspace = true
[dev-dependencies]
support.workspace = true
support/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "support"
version = "0.1.0"
edition.workspace = true
[dependencies]
service.workspace = true
